# Proximity — Feature Inventory (Phase 0, read-only safety net)

**Date:** 2026-09-10. **Status:** append-only reference. Do not edit existing sections; append new findings with date.
**Purpose:** record of every feature the current app has, screen by screen, before the Phase 2 presentation deletion. If a feature isn't here, there is no evidence it was preserved.
**Sources read verbatim:** `apps/proximity_app/lib/**` (100 Dart files), `apps/proximity_app/SCREEN_MAP.md`, root `README.md`, `PROXIMITY_DESIGN.md`, `PROXIMITY_UI_REDESIGN.md`, `apps/proximity_app/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
**Method:** 5 parallel read-only slices (entry+enroll / mark / live-hosting / records / shell+shared). No code was changed to produce this file.

Conventions below:
- **Does** = user-visible behavior. **Data** = reads/writes with exact symbols/collections. **Host vs presentational** = which `screens/` host owns timers/drivers/drafts vs which `features/` widgets are pure UI. **Edges** = error states, retry, platform gates, behavior not in the source docs. **Verbatim** = exact strings/constants quoted from code.

---

## 0. Global route table vs code (read this first)

Actual navigation shell is **not** the 3-tab bottom bar. There is **no `BottomNavigationBar`/`TabBar`/`NavigationBar` in code** — only `CupertinoNavigationBar` inside `AdaptiveScaffold`. The shell is `MaterialApp.home = switch(appMode)` + named-route table + `AdaptiveScaffold`:

- `AppMode { unset, student, prof, enroll, take }` (`lib/mode.dart`), seeded from `PROX_MODE` env (`student|prof|enroll|take`, else `unset`) — debug-only, release builds ignore the flag. `modeFromName` restores only `student|prof`; `enroll|take` never persist. `setMode` writes `store.writeMode(name|null)`, logs `mode prev → next`.
- `home`: `unset→LandingScreen`, `student→(kIsWeb?MyAttendanceScreen:StudentHomeScreen)`, `prof→ProfCoursesScreen`, `enroll→SetupFlowScreen (standalone EnrollIntroScreen deleted — SetupFlow-only enrollment)`, `take→TakeAttendanceScreen(courseName:'CS201')`.
- Named routes (`lib/routes.dart`): `welcome, roles, device | prof/courses, prof/courses/<course>[/export] (strict — anything else unknown) | live/<course> (exact shape — extra suffix unknown, never the host) | mark/* (no named routes — all phases land on the single StudentHomeScreen host) | enroll/capture|result (intro deleted — SetupFlow-only; EnrollFlow delegates to ProxNav.pushNamed so guards apply) | face/capture (native-only still sheet) | setup-flow (single ProxRoutes constant) | records/mine (MyAttendanceScreen; drill-down in-tab only) | account/face-id (requires enrollment) | debug/log`.
- Guards (order web → mobile → auth → role → enrollment): `isNativeOnly = enroll/* + face/capture + live/*` → web redirects to `myAttendance`. `isMobileOnly = enroll/*` → non-mobile (`!canUseFace()`) redirects to `MobileOnlyGuidanceScreen` (FaceBlockedCard + Open my records). Pure `ProxRouteGuard` auth/role/enrollment decisions + `normalizeProxRoute` + `isValidCourseSegment` (covered by `test/route_guards_current_test.dart`). Desktop CAN host `live/*`, never enroll. Unknown → `ProxRoutePlaceholder('Unknown route','This link does not match the route table yet…')`, never red-screen. `ProxRouteObserver` logs `NAV →/←/×/⇄`.
- **Divergences from SCREEN_MAP.md (spec-only, not in code):** no `SetupFlowScreen` stepper; no `account` / `account/*` routes at all; no `DetailsExpander`; no `features/manual_attendance/` module; no drawer log (full-screen `debug/log` only); routes still `records/*` (not `courses/*`); `device` still standalone (not folded into Account); no in-app theme switcher (fixed `ThemeMode.system`); avatar is initial-letter only (no Gmail photo fetched); `ManualInboxSection` uses `CheckboxListTile` + Select-all (not hold-and-tap); `CourseOverviewScreen` exposes `Take attendance` + `Retake` from the Courses surface (SCREEN_MAP §3.1a says hosting exclusively via Live — flag for rebuild).
- `lib/ui/` is empty (only `.DS_Store`). `lib/screens/` has exactly 4 files: `landing.dart, student_home.dart, take_attendance.dart, face_capture.dart`. Records screens have **no** `screens/` host — all 7 live in `features/records/`.

## 1. Entry (unauthenticated → hub)

### 1.1 `screens/landing.dart` — LandingScreen (thin router)
- **Does:** watches `accountProvider`; null → WelcomeScreen; non-null → RoleHubScreen; loading → `ProxLoadingRow('Loading…')`; error → `ProxErrorNote('Sign-in state unreadable: $e')`. Owns nothing else (header comment: no auth state, no cloud calls, no nav decisions).
- **Data:** reads `accountProvider` only. Writes none.
- **Host vs presentational:** pure thin host/router. All decisions in `features/entry/entry_flow.dart`.
- **Edges:** loading/error are terminal, no retry button (retry = auth-stream re-emit). No platform gate here.

### 1.2 `features/entry/welcome_screen.dart` — WelcomeScreen
- **Does:** hero (rings + `groups_outlined`, headline `Be there. Be marked.`, subline `Students prove room presence over Bluetooth with a face check; professors host from their phone. Online once — offline in class.`, title `Campus Attendance`) + `WebRecordsBanner` + explainer (`One sign-in for everyone. Students must sign in — each Gmail can hold only one enrolled student device (checked online). Professors may skip: classes then stay on this device only until you sign in and sync.`) + primary `Sign in with Google` → `entrySignIn` (null → `Sign-in cancelled.`) + secondary `Continue as Professor offline` (hidden on web) → `entryContinueOfflineProf`. Sub-note: `Offline professors keep everything on this device. Sign in later to back up, sync across devices, and share CSVs from the cloud.`
- **Data:** reads none directly; writes auth session via `AuthService.signInWithGoogle`. No Firestore/store writes in this file.
- **Host vs presentational:** host-leaning; owns `_busy/_status` wrapper, calls `entry_flow.dart`; `_WelcomeHero/_RingsPainter` pure paint. Timer `2400ms loop / 50ms tick`, started in `didChangeDependencies`, cancelled on dispose; reduced-motion → static `_progress=0.35`.
- **Edges:** sign-in throw → status text, stays. Offline-prof path never throws out. Web hides offline button.

### 1.3 `features/entry/entry_flow.dart` — orchestration owner for all entry
- **Does:** `entryGoto` (mounted-guarded `setMode` + `NAV entry → <mode>` log); `entrySignIn/SignOut` (sign-out clears auth + `clearRole` + `refreshFromAuth` + `linkedIdentity=null`, each try/catch); `entryContinueOfflineProf`; `entryRoleFor` (local cache hit else cloud `fetchRole` → merge → `writeRole`; stale `kStudentPurgeStale` → `purgeExpiredSelfData` best-effort; else stale cache); `entryRegisterProf` (online-required else `You appear offline — professor registration needs internet once…`; `setRole prof` + `writeHostName` + merge + `flushNow` + goto); `entryRegisterStudent` (online-required else `Student registration needs internet…`; runs `entryStudentGate`, throws `studentClaimMessage` if `!ok`); `entryStudentGate` (`getOrCreateInstallId` + `fetchStudentDevice` + `fetchInstallEmail` + local pkHex → `evaluateStudentClaim`; logs `entry claim gate <email> → <claim.name>`); `entryStampLastMode`; `entryContinueWithRole` (prof direct; **web student skips binding gate** → records; native student re-gates + `touchStudentDevice` heartbeat).
- **Data:** `authServiceProvider`, `deviceStoreProvider` (role/enrollment/installId/hostName), `cloudSyncProvider` (`users/{uid}`, `studentDevices/{emailLower}`, `deviceInstalls/{installId}`), `enrollmentControllerProvider`, `linkedIdentityProvider`, `appModeProvider`.
- **Edges:** offline prof/student register throw; offline continue proceeds local-only; StudentGate verdicts = `firstBind/sameDevice/allowedMove/cooldownBlocked/installConflict` (same as enroll claim). All post-local cloud writes best-effort.

### 1.4 `features/entry/role_hub_screen.dart` — RoleHubScreen (authenticated resume)
- **Does:** `ProxIdentityHeader(displayName,email,heldLabel)` + wrong-account note (`Note: this device is enrolled as ${linked.gmail} — different from the signed-in account. Wrong account? Switch below.`) + role load via cached `_roleFutures[emailLower]` (no refire). No roles → web: banner + `This sign-in holds no Proximity role yet. Register once in the native app, then return here to view records.`; desktop (`!canUseFace()`): prof-name field + `Register as Professor` only + `Student enrollment runs once in the mobile app (Android/iOS) — this desktop stays records + hosting only.`; mobile: `Register this sign-in (once per account):` + prof-name field + `Register as Professor` + `Register as Student` + `Same Gmail can hold both roles — switch anytime. Professor works on many devices; student enrollment lives on exactly one device (moves to a new phone once a month).` Has roles → `Continue as Professor/Student` last-mode-first (first primary) + `Last used — continues where you left off.` + add-other-role section + lost-phone note (`A student who lost their phone waits out the week for re-enrollment — meanwhile mark them manually from the take-attendance screen… No reset shortcut exists by design.`). Footer: `Device & identity` push + `Switch account (sign out)`.
- **Data:** reads linked identity + `entryRoleFor` chain; writes via register/continue/sign-out paths (see 1.3) + `touchStudentDevice` heartbeat.
- **Edges:** email mismatch (`role email != acct email`) forces register UI. `kIsWeb` → no registration. Copy inconsistency (not behavior): register section says `once a month`, add-other-role/lost-phone notes say `once a week`; code is 30-day `kStudentMoveCooldown` — `once a month` is accurate.

### 1.5 `features/entry/device_identity_screen.dart` — DeviceIdentityScreen (route `device`)
- **Does:** `Device & identity` / `Which account, which device.` / `One Gmail holds both roles; one phone holds one student enrollment.` + Signed-in section + (mobile only) This-device (`readEnrollment()` → `Enrolled as <email>` + `name · roll · key <first12>…` or `No student key on this device yet — enrollment creates one (device key + face, online once).`) + Move status (`entryStudentGate` → `firstBind: Not enrolled yet / This install is free to enroll — first bind takes it.`; `sameDevice: This device holds the enrollment / Re-keys and re-enrolls here are always free.`; `allowedMove: Eligible to move here / The 30 days since the last move have passed — enrolling here moves it (at most once a month).`; `cooldownBlocked/installConflict: ProxErrorNote(studentClaimMessage)`; every verdict appends `DeviceTrustBadge` if binding non-null) + offline-prof note + sign-out (pops after). Desktop/web: `Records view only here — enrollment, keys, and device moves live in the mobile app (Android/iOS).` + banner.
- **Data:** reads account/linked/enrollment/cloud gate; writes none except sign-out.
- **Edges:** offline → `Connect to check move status — one enrolled device per Gmail is checked online.` (never stale verdict). Trust tier always visible when binding exists.

## 2. Enrollment (mobile-only)

Orchestrator: `core/enrollment.dart` `EnrollmentController` (phases `signedOut,signedIn,keyReady,faceDone,uploaded,error`). Screens are thin callers. Face backend: `features/face_identity/` narrow `FaceVerifier` interface (plugin `face_verification ^0.3.9`, FaceNet gallery keyed by `faceIdOf = sha256(gmailLower+installId)`, never raw Gmail). Threshold `kFaceThreshold = 0.70` (plugin scale; old 0.60/0.80 EdgeFace numbers retired, never reused). `verifierVer = face_verification/0.3.9+b45ab893`.

### 2.1 `features/enrollment/enroll_intro.dart` — REMOVED (SetupFlow-only enrollment; content now SetupFlow Confirm device → Account & key steps)
- **Does:** `Enroll this device` + `One-time setup — about 2 minutes, online once…` + retry brief (`Getting a good scan sometimes takes 3–4 tries, no worries 🙂`) + 4-step card (Google account `Picked up silently from sign-in — no second tap.` / Device key `Generated on this phone, kept in secure storage.` / Five guided angles `Centre · Left · Right · Up · Down — small turns and tilts… The template never leaves this phone.` / Online claim `One enrolled student device per Gmail, checked online.`) + internet-once card + 30-day card (`One Gmail lives on one enrolled device at a time. A move to a new phone is allowed once every 30 days (unlimited times)… Stuck in between? Ask your professor for manual attendance…`) + account card (`Sign in with Google` or `Signed in as <display>\n<email>` + `EnrollRollField` ID Number, keyed by account) + key card (`Generate device key` or `Key: <first16>…`) + `Continue to face scan` (disabled without key).
- **Data:** reads `enrollmentControllerProvider` (account/pkHex/roll); calls `pickUpAccount/signIn/setRoll/generateKey`. Web → info card only (`Student registration needs the native app…`), no account/key UI. `!canUseFace()` → `FaceBlockedCard` + Back.
- **Edges:** silent pickup covers landing-signed students; manual button for fresh installs (claim cannot run unsigned).

### 2.2 `features/enrollment/enroll_capture.dart` — EnrollCaptureScreen (continuous session driver)
- **Does:** one camera open → auto loop (`600ms initial beat`, `600ms frame beat`, `50ms sweep tick`, `4500ms sweep revolution`, `sweepSpan 1.047`) classifying each still via `poseGate.readPose` → `EnrollBucketFill.classifyInto(yaw,pitch,roll,filled)` into `faceEnrollSlots [centre,left,right,up,down]`; rejects silent in UI, `BleLog` only; 5/5 → `ctl.enrollFace(paths)` → `faceDone` → `openResult`. Overlays `Positioned/IgnorePointer` only: `FaceCaptureOvalOverlay(progress,sweepAngle,sweepSpan)` + `EnrollAngleDots` + `EnrollNotice`. Bottom: validated → `Continue`; save-error → `Try again`; else static prompt `Rotate your face slowly, following the glow.` + hidden reservations (parity with FaceCaptureScreen so feed ratio stable). `Cancel` pops, logs `session cancelled — nothing enrolled (n/5 filled, discarded)`, enrolls nothing.
- **Data:** `enrollSessionCameraProvider` (Real/Fake), `enrollmentControllerProvider`, `poseGateProvider`. Gallery write single + terminal (plugin enroll + centre-still self-check; mid-loop throw → `remove(faceId)` + rethrow).
- **Edges:** denied → `Camera permission is needed for the face check — allow it in settings, then come back. Nothing is enrolled yet.`; failed → `The camera did not start — nothing is enrolled yet…`; no-key → `Generate the device key on the previous screen first…`. Save blocked till 5 validate. Reduced-motion → steady full-rim glow.
- **Pose windows (pure):** centre `|yaw|,|pitch| ≤ 12°`; side turns `8–35°`; tilts `8–30°`; off-axis `15°`; roll `≤ 20°`; null/unreadable fails closed.

### 2.3 `features/enrollment/enroll_result.dart` — EnrollResultScreen
- **Does:** `uploaded` → `ProxVerdictBadge.marked('✓ Done', restored&&score<=0 ? 'Key restored from this device — no fresh face match yet.' : 'Identity linked for attendance.')` + identity card + `Re-scan face` (key kept) + `Done` → `EnrollNav.finish` (popUntil non-`enroll/`). Else pending: `Save enrollment` + `One tap claims this Gmail's single student-device slot online — then attendance works fully offline.` + status card (`Key: <first16>… · Face: 5 of 5 stills captured|capture pending`, `ID: <roll>` or `ID: not entered — go back to the account step…`) + refusal `EnrollNotice` + `_nextStep` card + Save (disabled until `faceDone/uploaded`) + `Back to face scan`.
- **Refusal classification (string-match on controller message):** cooldown → `Next step: wait for the re-enroll date above — moves are unlimited, at most one per 30 days. Until then, ask your professor to mark your attendance manually…`; installConflict → `Next step: to switch identity here, clear the app data / reinstall and enroll again — one phone holds one student enrollment…`; offline → `Next step: connect to the internet and tap Save again — your capture is kept, no re-scan needed.`; pipeline → `Next step: your device key was kept — scan your face again on the previous screen…`; partial → capture 5 stills; roll → popUntil `enroll/` prefix (intro route deleted — SetupFlow-only).
- **Data:** reads controller; writes `linkedIdentityProvider` on success only. Claim refused → nothing stored locally.

### 2.4 `core/enrollment.dart` controller details (behavioral contract)
- `refreshFromAuth/pickUpAccount`: same-email adopts only if draft empty + `_tryRestore`; changed email wipes `_keys/_faceId/_restoredRoll`; offline keeps persisted account; `getIdToken` best-effort `6s`.
- `_requireLiveAccount`: session moved under draft → wipe + `error Signed out — sign in again…` / `Signed-in account changed to <email> — restart enrollment as the new account (previous progress was cleared).`
- `_tryRestore`: sealed `ensure` fail → `signedIn + 'This enrollment is bound to your phone — continue enrollment there.'`; `unseal restore detected` → `signedIn + 'restore detected — re-enroll'`; `isFaceStale(verifierVer)` → `keyReady + restored + 'Face recognition was improved — scan your face again.'`; else `uploaded + restored + 'Key restored from this device — no fresh match yet. Scan again to verify.'`
- `generateKey`: `ProxCrypto.generateEdKeypair`, `pkHex=hex(pub[0:32])`.
- `enrollFace`: requires 5 paths (`Capture 5 stills (centre, left, right, up, down) to enroll.`); blank → `The <slot> still came out blank — recapture just that angle…`; `faceIdOf(emailLower,installId)`; mid-loop throw → `remove` + rethrow; centre self-check must match else `remove` + `Face capture did not match clearly — recapture in good light, holding still.`
- `upload`: requires `faceDone` (`Scan your face first — the capture must validate before saving.`), account+key (`Complete all steps first.`), roll (`Enter your ID number to continue.`); org from `acct.org` else domain (`googlemail→gmail`); `requireMobileFace + ensure + seal + pkD`; offline → `Student enrollment needs internet (one enrolled device per Gmail is checked online). Connect and tap Save again — your face capture is kept.`; claim `StudentDeviceDoc` (email,uid,pkHex,name,roll,modelVer=verifierVer,installId,platform,org,pkDHex,attestationLevel,attestedAt/Until+90d); `StateError` → claim refused, nothing stored; then `writeEnrollment(StoredEnrollment…)` → `uploaded`.
- `restartFace`: `remove(oldFaceId)` best-effort, back to `keyReady`; stored face untouched (attendance works until new validates, Save blocked).
- **Note — 3-vs-5 discrepancy:** `README.md` robustness notes say enroll capture saves 3 stills (Centre/Left/Right) with save blocked until 3 register; `SCREEN_MAP.md` + all enroll code use 5 angles (centre/left/right/up/down). Rebuild's two-oval overlay must match the actual capture-controller code; report which count it is. (This inventory records both claims; resolution is a Phase 5 verification item, NOT a behavior change.)

### 2.5 `screens/face_capture.dart` — legacy still-capture shell (not in route table)
- `StillCapturer.capture(context,captures,autoFire,prompt)`; `FaceCaptureScreen` (permission + front lens + `ResolutionPreset.medium`, auto-fire after `500ms`, `350ms` gaps, blank guard `Capture produced no image — try again.`, Cancel → null); `FaceCaptureOvalOverlay(progress,sweepAngle,sweepSpan=1.047)` (dim `0x73000000`, glow 10px/0.22/blur10, ring 3px white 0.85, progress 5px round, beacon 7px + 16 slices; widths 0.72/0.78, heights 0.58/0.64; `progressGreen=markedDark`; steady glow alpha 0.45). Records-only → `FaceBlockedCard(flow:'Face check')`.
- No providers except `stillCapturerProvider`; no store/cloud/gallery here.

### 2.6 `features/face_identity/` support
- `face_verifier.dart`: interface `{init,enroll(5),verify(threshold),remove,embeddingFor,verifierVer}`; `PluginFaceVerifier` (native; unreadable guards before native; `enroll needs 5 stills (centre/left/right/up/down), got N`; per-slot `The <slot> still did not read clearly — recapture just that angle…`; verify `match?threshold:0.0` boundary-carried); `UnavailableFaceVerifier` (every op throws `<op> needs the mobile app (Android/iOS) — this device is records-only.`); `FakeFaceVerifier` test-only (scripted match/score/version, embedding 512×0.044).
- `device_key.dart`: `DeviceKey {ensure,pkD,sign,seal,unseal,level,attestedAt/Until,heartbeat}`; `PXK2` AES-GCM AAD-bound seal (email/installId/pkS/pkD); `SoftwareDeviceKey` debug/test-only (`level=none`, `Software-no-enroll` at the controller); `UnavailableDeviceKey` throws records-only; trust `FULL/STD→confirmed (chain-vs-pinned-roots + challenge + leaf-pkD bind), STALE(14d grace)→confirmed+banner, NONE→device-none-requires-approval manual path (never confirms), unbound→face-unbound/liveness-unbound (never confirms)`.
- `face_blocked.dart`: `FaceBlockedCard(flow)` — `<flow> needs the mobile app` + `This <browser/desktop/device> is records-only: enrollment and marking run on Android/iOS…` + `On your phone: sign in → enroll this device → join the class to mark.`
- `device_identity.dart`: re-export of `sync/claim.dart` (`getOrCreateInstallId/newInstallId`).
- `DeviceStore` interface (secure vs in-memory): enrollment, history, catalog, mode, hostName, lastHost, courses, session draft `{windowNo,dateIso,savedAt,names,rolls,windows,windowNos}`, role cache, installId (128-bit hex UUID; clones separate), hidden sessions, pendingAdds/pendingSessions/tombstones, org-backfill flag, studentSessions. `StoredEnrollment` incl. `isFaceStale` (faceId empty or verifierVer mismatch).

## 3. Student mark flow (highest UI weight)

Host: `screens/student_home.dart` `_StudentHomeScreenState` — owns ALL timers (`_refreshTimer 2s, _sessionTimer 15s, _roomPoll 2s, _presenceBeat 5s, _manualPoll 2s, _rewaitTimer 3s chain, _hintRetryTimers`), `runId` re-entry guard, `_waitingTarget`, `_connected/_roomWindowOpen/_roomMisses/_rewaitMisses`, `_roundMarks`, `_faceAttempts/_autoFaceTries/_autoFaceFired`, hints/session-ack/fails/pending/throttles, `_broadcastBlocked`, `_live`, typed-IP field state, wakelock, `relayEnabled`, `leaveWaiting`, `PopScope`, `MarkFlowShell` switch. Feature widgets are stateless with callbacks only. Driver: `core/student_driver.dart` (`Real/FakeStudentDriver` via `studentDriverProvider`): face verify, `listenAndProve` loop, `_prove`, presence/leave/manual/poll/prewarm, `FaceGate`, `ClockDriftTracker`. Phases enum: `browsing,waiting,faceCheck,listening,marked,late,wrongOrg,needsReview,noSignal,paused,manualPending`. `MarkFlowShell`: `AnimatedSwitcher(medium, Fade+Slide(0,0.12), KeyedSubtree(phase))`; reduced-motion → instant.

### 3.1 `mark/browse` — BrowseClassesView
- **Does:** `ClockHeader` + identityLine + (`linked==null && canUseFace()` → `Enroll this device (face + ID)`; `linked==null && !canUseFace()` → `Records view only here — enrollment and marking run in the mobile app (Android/iOS).`) + `My attendance records (synced)` + `JoinByIpSection` (IP+port, `Join`) + `Live on this WiFi` + `LadderLine` + live tiles (`title classLabel`, `subtitle [prof,profEmail,host,Code,org].join(' · ')`, dot pulse iff windowOpen, trailing chevron or `idle`) + footer `Keep app in foreground. Backgrounding shows Paused — reopen.` Empty → `No live classes heard yet. Stay on the classroom WiFi — professors appear here when they start hosting. If nothing appears, type the IP shown on the professor's screen above (Bluetooth must be on for auto-discovery).` Blocked → `Classroom WiFi blocks discovery broadcasts — showing BLE-hinted classes only (hint+probe rung). Stay on the classroom WiFi.` Pull-refresh = local recompute only (never network scan — enterprise APs kicked phones off WiFi under probe load).
- **Data:** reads linked/identityLine/live list/blocked flag/gated-email map (prof email ONLY from gated `/window` unicast, never beacons/BLE); writes typed IP via `writeLastHost` on every change, pre-fills from `readLastHost`.
- **Trust + round per tile:** verify label renders as a footer pill (tag first, Open just right of it — the title line carries no pills); the live round number from the same gated unicast (`windowNo`) renders as an under-disc ordinal (`1st Class`, hidden when 0/unknown, avatar column only).
- **Discovery constants:** `kDiscoveryPort 54545`, `kDiscoveryInterval 2s`, `kDiscoveryExpiry 12s` (one missed 10s rotation + margin), `kSessionPersist 120s`, `kSessionRefresh 15s`, `kSessionMaxFails 3`; live-refresh `2s`; browse watchdog `restartScanIfSilent(30s)`; BLE-hint throttle 1 probe/host/10s; pending-hint fast retry `3s` until answered or `>2min` aged out; gated-email backfill 1 fetch/host/15s; `broadcastBlocked = beacons.isEmpty && hints.isNotEmpty`; org-gated (mismatch never listed; legacy `''` passes); dedupe `host:port` (beacons win); sort firstSeen.
- **Ladder:** `degradationLadder = [BLE hint + probe, typed IP + BLE, LAN manual IP, offline direct manual-add]`; `ladderStepFor(bleOn,hintHeard,unicastOk)`; assumptions: UDP advisory-only (expected DEAD on enterprise APs); HTTPS unicast HARD REQUIREMENT (only path that marks); BLE hint + probe relied-upon (hint unverified, gates unchanged); internet never probed in live flow; BLE-off → tappable Turn-on else honest noSignal.

### 3.2 `mark/join` (merged into browse) — JoinByIpSection + IpJoinField
- **Does:** dotted-quad box (digits+dots, 15 chars, `hint 192.168.43.1`, key `ipfield`) + port box (digits, 5 chars, `hint 8443`, key `ipport`, default `8443`) + caption `Shown by the professor in class.` + `Join` + `ProxErrorNote(joinError)`. `normalizeIp` ignores empty segments (`192..168.43.1` resolves), requires 4× `0–255`; port `1–65535` else null. (SCREEN_MAP: surfaces as FallbackButton→sheet in redesign; current code inline to preserve tested `ipfield/ipport` + `Join` contract.)
- **Join:** null → `Enter the professor IP shown in class.`; else `NAV join by IP … → waiting`, `writeLastHost`, clear trail, enter waiting.

### 3.3 Join gates + Bluetooth prompt (host, pre-waiting/pre-face)
- `_checkJoinGates`: `linked==null` → `Enroll this device first — identity is required.`; no BLE perm → `Bluetooth permission is required for proximity proofs. Enable it in Settings and rejoin.`; BT off → `requestEnableBluetooth`, still off → `Bluetooth is off — turn it on to join the class.` Unknown/unavailable stacks proceed.
- `promptEnableBluetoothIfOff` dialog: title `Bluetooth is off`, body `Turn it on to see classes and prove presence — without it the app can neither hear nor announce.`, actions `Later / Turn on` → `retryPendingScan`. Scan started while off defers + restarts on power-on (Turn-on retries at once, Settings-enable via engine poll). Records-only L1: `canUseFace() = isAndroid||isIOS`; `requireMobileFace` throws `Face verification needs the mobile app (Android/iOS) — this device is records-only.`

### 3.4 `mark/waiting` — WaitingRoomView + host enter/poll
- **Does:** `Connected/Not connected` badge (pulse iff connected) + `Connected — waiting for professor to start marking` / `Not connected — check WiFi / IP` + `Attendance has not yet started for\n$roomClass.\nKeep this open — you will continue automatically when the professor starts marking.` + host line + (if `!connected`) `Honestly unreachable right now — check the IP and that both devices are on the same WiFi. Presence retries every 2s; hosting that ended returns you to the live list.` + (if trail) `This session: R1 · KQ7 · …` + `Request manual attendance` + `Cancel`. Join never starts face scan — registers presence + pre-warms BLE + parks; window-open auto-advances to face with no taps.
- **Data:** `POST /waiting {email,name,roll,org}` presence (reply carries `leaveToken`); `GET /window?org=` probe → `WindowProbe(reachable,windowOpen,classLabel,waiting,display,org,profEmail)`; `POST /leave {email,leaveToken}` fire-and-forget on Cancel/back/dispose (token required — missing/mismatch 403s, no membership oracle).
- **Transitions:** enter (gates → prewarm → stop room timers → `waiting, connected=false, misses=0` → best-effort presence + immediate probe → if open advance; else `presenceBeat 5s` + `roomPoll 2s`); poll (unreachable `++misses>=5` → `Class ended — back to the live list.` + drop host entries; else misses=0, cache email, set connected/open); backup advance only if connected + live-list entry still windowOpen (stale-OPEN guard). Gated silence (org-mismatch) reads like hosting-ended. Cancel/Back/system-back: `runId++`, timers off, `/leave`, relay off, → browsing (never exits mid-flow; browsing back → `setMode(unset)`).

### 3.5 `mark/face` — FaceCheckView + host auto-scan
- **Does:** `FaceOval(progress:1.0, prompt:'Position your face in the oval')` + `Professor started marking — look at the camera, scanning starts by itself.` + `BLE listening` dot + notice line + `Scan face` (fallback/retry; disabled when no target/identity). Zero-tap auto-scan once per entry; manual tap sets fired first (no double-push). Radio keeps listening under camera UI.
- **Face semantics:** pass → stamp `FaceGate`, continue to proving. `mismatch` (readable wrong person) → burns 1 of 4 attempts → `needsReview`. `inconclusive` (no enrollment/face/unreadable) → never burns; auto-retry 2 (`Scan unclear — retrying automatically… (n of 2)`) else `Could not read that scan — adjust light and try again.` `staleTemplate` → `Face recognition was updated — re-enroll this device from the home screen, then join again.` (nothing signed). `blocked` → records-only notice. Cancel exits loop.
- **Driver checkFace:** empty-path guard (no plugin call); enrollment/pipeline read throw → inconclusive; `stored==null` → inconclusive; faceId empty/stale → staleTemplate; `verify` match → pass (score carried at threshold boundary, bound into ticket), fail → mismatch, throw → inconclusive. `requireMobileFace` first.

### 3.6 `mark/proving` — ProvingView + host listen + driver listenAndProve
- **Does:** `Proving…` + status `Waiting for the class signal… / Signal heard — proving… / Proof sent — confirming…` (ProxSwitcher, no countdown, no round clock) + clock-drift banner if any. Host: `run=++runId`, cancel rewait, wakelock on, `phase=listening`; `receipt=await listenAndProve(onStatus…)`; wakelock off; marked/late → `_roundMarks.add('R${n+1} · ${detail}')`, log `verdict <name> (<detail>)`, route to marked/late/needsReview(faceFailed)/noSignal/wrongOrg; marked/late → rewait-after-round.
- **Driver loop:** L1 gate else `('Marking needs the mobile app (Android/iOS)',error)`; re-entry guard `Already proving — wait for the current round`; enrollment check (`Not enrolled on this device` / `Face recognition was updated — re-enroll this device, then join again`); stamp FaceGate if score≥threshold; `clearSightings`, relay on; loop: `_waitNewChallenge` → null → probe (flake → continue; open → `round still open — kept waiting…` + continue; else relay off + `Round ended — stay put for the next one` noSignal) → else linger-relay-20s + `_prove`.
- **_prove:** key decode (`restore detected — re-enroll` terminal); `fetchWindow` org-mismatch → `Wrong organization for this class — join your institute class` (wrongOrg, no proof sent); other StateError → `_TryNext window fetch (…)` (only prof-sig-mismatch suspicious); `FaceGate.requireFreshForSign` else `Face check expired — scan again` terminal; `advertiseStudentResponse` best-effort; face vector `faceVecEncode(embeddingFor)` fail-soft (`session vector unavailable … — proving bare`); `prove(...)` → clock sample; invalid window-mismatch/bad-challenge/no-sighting or late stale-sub-epoch → `_TryNext`; `verifyAck` false → `Bad professor signature`; true → `confirmed: <display> · <stamp>` marked / `late: Late · <stamp>` / `invalid: Not marked [<reason>]`.
- **Timing (verbatim):** `silenceCap 45s` per wait then one probe decides; `scanRestartSlice 15s` quiet re-arm; relay linger `20s` reschedulable (newer extends, older never cuts; never cuts at own ACK); `spookStreak>=6` unverifiable → `No valid class signal — …`; refused (`Connection refused`) → `Professor unreachable at host:port — check the IP` fast-fail; transient (`Timeout/Socket/Http/Handshake/reset/unreachable/no-route`, never refused) → next token; HTTPS connects all bounded (`connectionTimeout 6s`, probe `4s`, post `8s/6s`, manual-status `4s×3`, fetchWindow `8s/8s/10s`, prove 3 attempts + jitter + `14s` each); rate limits `/prove 40/10s/IP`, `/window 5/10s/IP`; `kFaceValidWindow 5min`, `kFaceMaxRetries 2`, `kFaceMaxSessions 4`, `kFaceRescanInterval 12s`; `kChallengeBytes 8`, `kSubEpochSeconds 10`, `kFreshness 7s`, rotation new token every 10s unbounded; crypto-valid POST waits up to 4s for sighting; response waits for radio (never skips under relay load); clock banner `kClockDriftBannerSecs 5`, window 9, ≥3 samples: `Clock drift ~<n>s vs professor — marks may read late; check automatic date & time.`
- **Backgrounding:** `paused|hidden|detached` during listening/faceCheck → `runId++`, log `backgrounded during <phase> → paused`, `phase=paused` (`Paused — reopen` + `Back to join`); `inactive` never pauses; resume → `flushNow`.
- **Per-round trail:** `_roundMarks 'R1 · KQ7 · 10:04:12'` oldest-first, cleared on fresh join, shown on waiting + marked/late; professor shows `R1 ✓ · R2 ✗`; rounds noted at Stop not after grace (empty rounds count; intersection never sticks 1/1 after 2 rounds).

### 3.7 `mark/verdict` — MarkVerdictView
- **Does:** marked → `ProxVerdictBadge.marked` + trail + `Stay put — the next round rejoins automatically.` (parks, no buttons). late → badge + trail. wrongOrg → `WrongOrgCard` + `No proof was sent — join your institute class instead.` + `Back to classes`. needsReview → `Face check didn't match the enrolled face — try again in good light, holding still.` + (`attemptsLeft=4-_faceAttempts` >0 → `Retry face scan (N left)` → faceCheck + auto-scan; else `Request manual attendance instead` + `Back`). noSignal → `ProxVerdictBadge(noSignal,'No signal', infoDetail||detail)` + `Try again` → browsing. Covers dead-air closed, `Not marked […]`, `Bad professor signature`, `Professor unreachable…`, `Prove failed: …`.
- **Rewait (marked parks till round ends, zero taps):** chained `Timer(3s)` poll while `phase==marked|late && run==runId`: unreachable `++misses>=2` → ended; reachable → misses=0; `!windowOpen` → rewait; open → rewait iff `display` changed (fresh code = next round). ended → `hosting ended (was …) → live list, no re-face` + drop host entries + `Class ended — back to the live list.`; rewait → `round over (was …) → waiting for next` + enter waiting (prof/email/org preserved). Same-window re-face impossible (leave only on closed/unreachable/changed-code).

### 3.8 `mark/manual` — ManualRequestView + host poll
- **Does:** `approved → Manual attendance approved — marked present.` / `rejected → Manual request declined (marked absent) — see professor.` / else `Manual request sent — waiting for professor approval…` + (`!decided` → `Waiting…`) + `Back`. Host: `POST /manual-request` → `phase=manualPending, status=pending` (catch → `Manual request failed: $e`, back to waiting) → `Timer.periodic(2s)` poll → approved → cancel + `Marked present (manual approval)` + marked; rejected → cancel + park (stays showing verdict).

## 4. Professor live hosting

Host: `screens/take_attendance.dart` `TakeAttendanceScreen(courseName,autoStart)` — owns hosting/window/draft orchestration, composes `features/live/*` sections. Driver: `core/host_driver.dart` (`Real/FakeHostDriver` via `hostDriverProvider`): hosting lifecycle, radio, tally. Layout: `ClockHeader`, idle WiFi note + `LadderLine`, `LiveSetupSection`, `DraftResumedBanner`, `LiveSessionHeader`, `WaitingListSection`, `ManualInboxSection`, `DirectAddSection`, `DupFlagSection`, `MarkedRosterSection` in `ListView(16)` + `System log` action.

### 4.1 Host lifecycle (take_attendance + host_driver)
- `initState`: `_host()`, `_loadName()`, BT prompt post-frame (`Bluetooth off is otherwise a log-only failure: prompt once, up front, with a tappable Turn-on`).
- `_host()`: BLE perm first → `startHosting(courseName)` → `hosting=true`, `serverLine`, `_ip`, `serverError=permWarn ?? lanSelfCheckWarning`; log assumptions + ladder; `_restoreDraft()`; `_idlePoll 2s` (autosave + `refreshAnnounceIps` + waiting-delta log); `autoStart → _startNext()`.
- `startHosting` (driver): `_hostingBusy` guard (`Already starting hosting.`); enrollment → ephemeral lecture key if none (published best-effort to `profDevices/{email}` for student pinning — never blocks offline hosting); `_sessionId=rand(128)`; org=`roleOrg` (offline→`''`); prof email lowercased; `ProxServer` + `_bindWithRetry` (6 attempts, `150ms×attempt`, retry EADDRINUSE/Socket) + `_awaitHttpsReady` (poll 127.0.0.1/window till 200, deadline `4s`, `150ms`); LAN IPs WiFi-first else `['this-device']`; logs `HTTPS up on …`, `announcing as …`, `reachability check: open https://… in a phone browser …`; `lanSelfCheck` (best-effort GET own IP `2s`; fail → `Students on WiFi can't reach https://… from this Mac itself (…) — allow incoming connections… pick another announce IP, or turn VPN off…`); legacy-TX flag `!(Android||Linux)` (`legacy v1 TX (challenge + IP-hint ticks)`); `setServerIp` (or `clearServerIp` + `no LAN IP — connect WiFi…; BLE hint off`); `ClassAnnouncer` (never 127.0.0.1; beacons every 2s, log on targets-change else every 10th live/5th idle: `beacon sent … OPEN/idle → N targets`); `startIdleHintRotation` (`idle IP-hint rotation on (waiting discoverable)`). Returns `https://ip:port · waiting for window` (default port 8443).
- `_startNext/_start(n)` single-flight (`_starting` — no overlapping windows): perm re-check, `_ensureBt` (`Bluetooth is off — turn it on to start the window.`), `driver.startWindow(n)` → wakelock on, `live=true`, `_windowNo=n`, elapsed zero + `_t 1s` (autosave + waiting-delta + elapsed). Elapsed-up only, never auto-closes. `startWindow` (driver): `Start hosting first.` if none; `refreshAnnounceIps` first (heal stale mobile-data IP); fresh `WindowParams(sessionId,windowId,s…ecret,t0)`; `server.openWindow`; log `window #n open code=…`; relay off (`mesh off (prof originates, never relays)`); scan + `startProfRotation` (`prof advertising challenges (10s rotation)`; fail → unwind closeWindow+stopScanOnly + rethrow). Returns `https://ip:port · Code …`.
- `_closeWindow/_stopEarly`: cancel tick, `live=false`, wakelock off, `driver.stopWindow`, save draft + snapshot. `stopWindow` (driver): log `window stopping (rotation off, proofs accepted 10s more)`; **`noteWindow(n)` NOW (not after linger)** so empty/late-only rounds count and intersection never sticks 1/1; scan lingers + server accepts proofs (`scanLinger 10s`), then `post-window grace done (window closed, scan off)`; final `window stopped (grace running)`. Retake/end cancel timer and own window immediately.
- `_endAttendance`: final snapshot, `clearSession(course)`, null record id/start/org, `driver.endHosting`, pop. `endHosting` (driver): clear face vectors + dups, announcer stop, engine stop + clearServerIp, server stop, log `serve down (hosting ended)` iff was hosting, reset tally/session/keys/label.
- `_leave` (Back/`PopScope canPop:false`): cancel timers, save draft, `endHosting`, pop; log `leaving take screen (draft saved, hosting down)`. `dispose`: cancel timers, wakelock off, save draft only if `tally.size>0` (empty visit never overwrites good draft), `endHosting`.
- Snapshot `_saveSnapshot`: skip if `tally.size==0`; stable `_recordId ??= 'live-<course>-<micros>'`, fixed `_recordStartIso`, immutable `_recordOrg`; `tally.toClassRecord(…)` → `syncEngine.noteLocalSave`; log `snapshot upserted <id> (<n> present)`. Every round close AND every manual action upserts the SAME record — un-closed sessions still leave data.
- Draft `{windowNo,dateIso,recordId,recordStartIso,recordOrg,savedAt,names,rolls,windows,windowNos}`; `_draftSig = windowNo|windows|size|confirmedCount`; `_saveDraft` clears when `size==0 && windowNo==0`; `_maybeAutosave` single-flight (`_saving`).
- `FakeHostDriver`: demo `waiting for window` / `Code KQ7`, marks Student One/Two (`student@example.com` family), mirrors windows/manual/dup/restore.

### 4.2 `features/live/live_session.dart` — LiveSessionHeader
- **Does:** `LIVE/IDLE` (`letterSpacing 3`) + `ProxDot(pulse=live)` + elapsed `mm:ss` unbounded + `PresentTicker` (denom = waiting>0?waiting:present>0?present:0, never 0/0; `Window 1 · P present / D waiting` or `Windows 1–N (T taken) · intersection P / D waiting` + hostLine) + controls (live → `Stop`; `windowNo==0` → `Start` + `End attendance`; else → `Retake round N` + `Take another round` + `End attendance`; all non-live disabled when `!hosting`). Retake = same number fresh secrets marks-merge (no new intersection hurdle); Another = N+1. Pure presentational (props only).
- Present rule (behavioral law, enforced in roster): present = intersection of ALL windows taken.

### 4.3 `features/live/live_setup.dart` — LiveSetupSection + IP dialog
- **Does (idle-time only):** `!hosting && no error` → `Starting host…`; `hosting && !live` → guidance (`Advertising on WiFi + Bluetooth — students can see this class now and join the waiting area. Tap Start when the class has joined. If students on institute WiFi can't see it, have them type the IP shown below (this screen) with Bluetooth on — discovery broadcasts are advisory, the typed IP always works.`) + name field (`Your name (optional, shown to students)`) ; `serverLine` text; `Announcing on <ip> · change` when >1 IP (disabled live); `ProxErrorNote(serverError)`. Dialog `Announce on` + `Cancel`. Parent wires name → `setDisplayName` (persists `writeHostName`), IP → `setAnnounceHost` (log `announce IP switched…`), errors from perm/`lanSelfCheckWarning`. VPN-vs-WiFi noted as top `can't find me` cause. `refreshAnnounceIps` heals stale IP, never overrides explicit pick of still-present IP.

### 4.4 `features/live/live_roster.dart` — WaitingListSection, MarkedRosterSection, DupFlagSection, rosterTicksFor
- `rosterTicksFor(wins,windowNos)`: empty → `no rounds yet`/`R1 ✓`; else `R<n> ✓/✗` joined ` · `.
- `WaitingListSection`: `Waiting area (n)`; empty → `No students in the waiting area yet.`; rows keyed `waiting-<email>` (`hourglass_top`, name||email, `rosterSubtitle(roll,email)`); waiting rows carry no trust pill (no proof to judge yet).
- Marked rows carry a small trust pill (`rosterTrustTag`): Verified green on clean proofs, Unverified yellow on `faceFlag` (tainted device / dup-face pair member). The `Attendance` header trails `Class N` (live round count, hidden at 0).
- `MarkedRosterSection` (owns `_search`, key `prof-search`, `Search by name, ID, or email`): `Present — all rounds (P) · 1 round/N rounds`; empty → `Nobody present in every round yet — partials stay listed below.`; confirmed rows (intersection-gated, partial never promotes via search; partials suppressed during search); `Partial — some rounds (n)` rows (`timelapse`, ticks + subtitle + ` · late`); present rows no stagger (settle note: cascade would cross LIVE 800ms pulse).
- `DupFlagSection`: `Needs review — duplicate face (n)`; `Duplicate face detected between <A (a@x), B (b@x)> — both stay marked; this sometimes happens with siblings. Tap below if these are different people.`; `Not a duplicate/Resolving…` → `driver.resolveDupFlag` (clears whole group + exempts pair; presence untouched). Never accusation (twins known FP), never auto-absent. Driver: `_applyDupFaceToken` parses `dupface:a,b|…`, symmetric groups, log `duplicate face flagged: …`.
- `matchResponse`: all air matches → `hop:0` (packets carry no TTL, all arrive ttl==3; `hop:s.ttl` would reject every prove as no-sighting); log `response sighting match rssi=… hop=…`.

### 4.5 `features/live/manual_inbox.dart` — ManualInboxSection
- **Does:** `Manual requests (n)` + `Select all/Clear all` + empty `No manual requests.` + rows `CheckboxListTile(dense, title name||email, subtitle roll · email, Approve/Reject icon buttons)` + bulk `Approve selected/Reject`. Owns `_selected` (lowercased RAM only). Delegates to host (driver `decideManual` + draft + snapshot); clears decided rows. Logs `manual approved/rejected <email>`, `manual bulk approved/rejected (n)`.
- Current state uses checkboxes + Select-all — rebuild replaces with hold-and-tap + `features/manual_attendance/` module (does not exist yet).

### 4.6 `features/live/direct_add.dart` — DirectAddSection
- **Does:** `Direct manual entry` + unified `ManualAddForm(fieldPrefix:'direct', course, sessionId=_recordId ?? '', onAdd: driver.addManualEntry, isPresent: intersection-check)`. Thin wrapper; form owns search/submit/queue (see 4.8).

### 4.7 `features/live/draft_recovery.dart` — policy + prompts + banner (persistence stays on host)
- Policy: `recoverPromptThreshold = 150min (2.5h)`; `shouldPromptRecover(savedAt,now)`; `draftAgeLine` (`25m/3h/2d ago`, `a while ago`); `showRecoverOldDialog` (barrier-off, `Recover old session?` / `An autosaved session from <age> is still here. Recover it to continue, or save it to history and start fresh.` / `Save & start fresh` / `Recover`); `DraftResumedBanner` (`Resumed autosaved session` / `<P> present · <T> window[s] so far — retake the round, take again, or end attendance.` / `Discard`).
- Host `_restoreDraft`: ignore empty; old (>150m) → dialog → recover (`old draft recovered (continue same visit)`) else archive + fresh (`old draft archived, starting fresh visit`); recent → auto-archive to history + resume live zero taps (`recent draft auto-archived + resumed live, no prompt`). Archive restores temp tally → `upsertHistory`, no-op if empty (`draft archived to history (N marked)`). Apply restores tally + windowNo/date/record id/start/org + `_resumed=true` (window stays closed — professor taps Take another). Discard clears draft + tally (`draft discarded by professor (tally cleared)`). Same record id → no duplicates on End.

### 4.8 `widgets/manual_add.dart` — ManualAddForm (unified live + session-edit)
- **Does:** 3 fields ARE directory search (`ID Number (required)` / `Student name (fills from ID when online)` / `Student email (fills from ID when online)`, keys `<prefix>-roll|-name|-email` with `direct-*` live / `edit-*` session-edit, all `Searches the online student directory`, `cloud_outlined` suffix; header `Type to search the online directory — tap a card to fill:`). Typing live-searches (400ms debounce `ProxDurations.searchDebounce`, parallel single-field prefix queries `limit(10)` each merged capped 10, stale generations dropped; name waits 2 chars, ID/email fire at 1; online probe cached 15s, `6s` timeout; failure log throttled 10s `SYNC ManualAdd directory search failed: …`). Tap card fills all three (or `Already marked present.` if intersection-present — partials still go through). Submit: full name+valid email → add at once; ID-only + online + exact-ID match → `Matched online: <name>` + add; ID-only + online + no match → `No enrolled student with this ID — type the name + email as well, or retry online.` / `Enter a valid email.`; ID-only + offline → queue `PendingManualAdd(course,sessionId,roll,name,email,now,org)` → `No internet — queued. It applies automatically on the next sync.` + clear fields; empty roll → `ID Number is required.` Search states: `Searching online…`, `Directory unreachable — your entry still saves (queued when needed).`, `Directory search failed: <err>` (rules-denied names redeploy — never swallowed as "no students"), `No enrolled students match — they enroll once online in the native app.` (gated so 1-char name never reads as no-match). Button `Add & mark present` (busy spinner).
- **Data:** `cloud.searchStudents(roll/nameLower/email + org==myOrg)`, `cloud.isOnline`, `store.readRole→roleOrg`, `store.read/writePendingAdds`; via `onAdd → driver.addManualEntry` (live: `key=lower.trim`, ignore empty/non-`@`; lands in current (or first — windows number from 1) round; `registerWaiting`; visible at once) or session-edit equivalent. Re-exports `core/sync/queue.dart` (`processPendingAdds, PendingManualAdd, SyncQueue`). Queue resolves on next course sync; live drafts excluded so queue never races tally.

### 4.9 `widgets/partial_list.dart` — pure roster math (no widgets)
- Union = everyone seen in any session (no schema; synced sessions carry names/rolls; newcomer reads absent earlier — matches matrix). `courseRoster` (oldest-first so newest name/roll wins, sorted name.lower); `ticksForWindows` (`R1 ✓ · R2 ✗`); `rosterSubtitle(roll,email)` (`10000001 · a@x.in`, email alone when no roll — shared by live/inbox/detail/edit/partial rows); `partialCountOf` (0 if ≤1 window, else some&&!all); `partialsOfCourse` (skip single-round; label `dateIso||classLabel`; per-email `(sessionId,label,ticks)`; sorted name).

### 4.10 `features/live/live_sections.dart` — focused deep-link screens (same host driver)
- `_LiveSectionShell(title,reason,child)`; `_noHostNote(course)` = `No live host for <course> on this device right now — open Take attendance on its course to host, then return here.`
- `LiveRosterScreen`: `Roster · <course>` / `Who is waiting, present, or partial — live.` + waiting + dup + marked sections (cold → noHost guidance, never crash).
- `LiveInboxScreen`: `Inbox · <course>` / `Approve or reject manual requests — mid-class.` + inbox (single decide also snapshots via `noteLocalSave` if `tally.size>0`).
- `LiveAddScreen`: `Add · <course>` / `Add one student by hand — directory search fills the fields.` + direct-add (`sessionId:''`).
- `LiveSetupScreen`: `Setup · <course>` / `Hosting setup before Start — back to the host to begin.` + `Setup lives on the live host screen (name, announce IP, discovery assumptions). This section names the step so live/<course>/setup deep-links land somewhere real.` + `Back to live host` + `System log`.

## 5. Records / Courses (both shells, records-only)

No `screens/` host for any of these 7 — all self-contained `ConsumerStatefulWidget`s in `features/records/`, pushed via `MaterialPageRoute`. Helpers: `widgets/course_attendance.dart` (pure summary), `widgets/csv_preview.dart` (dialog), `widgets/partial_list.dart` (math), `core/sync/sessions.dart` (merge/tombstones/docs), `core/sync/engine.dart` (flush), `core/sync/store/record_helpers.dart` (`recordInCourse`, `dateIsoOf`, `todayIso`).

### 5.1 `features/records/my_attendance_screen.dart` — MyAttendanceScreen (`records/mine`; spec renames to `courses/mine`)
- **Does:** student records landing. `ClockHeader` + `WebRecordsBanner` + email line + totals `$totalAttended present · $totalTaken synced sessions` (tabular) + course cards (`ProxListTile(folder, title course, subtitle 'x/y days attended[ · n partial]', trailing 'p/s' + chevron, stagger i)`) → `CourseAttendanceDetailScreen` (`NAV my-attendance → <course>`, hide-inside reloads list) + `System log` action + pull-refresh.
- **Data:** auth email/org (`acct.org else orgOf(email)`); offline → `readStudentSessions` cache; online → `cloud.pullStudentSessions(email,org)` then `writeStudentSessions` (same order, newest-first); filter `!hidden`; group `courseOfRecord` (`courseId else classLabel`); `summarizeCourse`. Writes only cache + hidden. Logs `my-attendance: offline/pulled …`.
- **Edges:** A–Z courses; newest-first inside; offline non-empty → `Offline — showing last synced records.`; offline empty → `You appear offline — connect to load synced records.`; online footer `Synced from your professors. Removing hides it here only.`; empty `No synced classes yet. Professors sync after marking — pull down to refresh when online.`; unsigned `Sign in to view your synced attendance.` Device-only hide lives in detail.

- **Edges:** empty `No sessions in this course.` Banner unconditional (widget no-ops native).

### 5.3 `features/records/prof_courses_screen.dart` — ProfCoursesScreen (`prof/courses`)
- **Does:** course picker (`manage courses half of old course page`). `ClockHeader` + banner + sync note + `UnsyncedBadge` + `Host: <name>[ · <roll>]` + (`!kIsWeb` → `Register new course`) + rows (`folder`, `name`, `<n> sessions · <Fri, 4 Sep|no sessions yet>`, chevron) → `CourseOverviewScreen` (`courses → overview <name>`) + `System log` + `Switch mode` + `PopScope(canPop:false → setMode unset)`.

### 5.4 `features/records/course_overview_screen.dart` — CourseOverviewScreen (`prof/courses/<course>`)
- **Does:** one-course management. Sync note + badge + (`!kIsWeb` → `Take attendance` play_arrow → `TakeAttendanceScreen(autoStart)`; `Review & export` ios_share (disabled when empty) → ExportCenter) + `$rosterCount people · <n> sessions` (union roster) + multi-delete (`Delete selected (n)` when selected && `!kIsWeb`) + session rows (`title sessionTightLabel 'CS201 · Thu, 3 Sep · 10:00'`, subtitle `roomyLine + P present · W window(s)[\nPartial (n)]`, leading Checkbox (`!kIsWeb`), trailing Export CSV + Retake, tap → SessionDetail) + bottom (`!kIsWeb` → `Delete course` delete_outline, null when empty) + `System log` + rename (edit icon → `Edit course` / `Course name` / `Cancel/Save`; `Name unchanged — empty or already used.`; `renameCourseLocal` migrates history + re-queues same doc ids with new courseId + flush + pop back).
- **Data:** `readHistory` filter `recordInCourse` sort `timestampIso` desc; `_syncFromCloud` (`flushNow`) on init + after take; delete course/sessions via `deleteSessionsLocal` (tombstone first, then catalog) + `deleteCourse` + flush; logs `overview: deleted course <name> (<X> students/<Y> sessions)`, `overview: deleted <n> sessions (…)`, `overview <c> → take|export|session|system log`.
- **Edges:** newest-first; `Partial (n)` one-liner multi-round only; union-as-absent; `X/Y warning` verbatim both dialogs (`This will delete attendance data of <X> students for <Y> sessions. This cannot be undone.`, titles `Delete course <name>?` / `Delete sessions?`); `X` = unique students present even once, `Y` = selected count; offline `Offline — showing this device only.`; empty `No sessions yet for this course.`; web hides Take/Retake/Edit/Delete-selected+Checkbox/Delete-course; export stays. **Flag:** Take + Retake exposed here diverge from §3.1a (hosting exclusively via Live).

### 5.5 `features/records/session_detail_screen.dart` — SessionDetailScreen (`prof/sessions/<id>` read)
- **Does:** `${classLabel} · ${fullDateOf(dateIso)}[ · ${shortTimeOf(timestamp)}]` + `$present present · <n> listed[ · Partial (n)]` + (`!kIsWeb` → `Fix marks` → SessionEdit; `Export CSV` always → ExportCenter) + `Attendance` rows (`title name`, `subtitle ticks · roll · email`, leading check_circle marked / timelapse partial / circle outline) + `System log`. Web banner only here (`if kIsWeb`).
- **Data:** in `record + courseSessions` (union context); derived intersection present / some-partial / ticks; `_reload` after editor (`readHistory`, match id, setState). Writes none.

### 5.6 `features/records/session_edit_screen.dart` — SessionEditScreen (`prof/sessions/<id>/edit`)
- **Does:** fix saved record, presence PER WINDOW. Person rows `ExpansionTile(dense, leading Checkbox tristate, title name||email, subtitle '<p>/<w> rounds · roll · email', trailing Remove, children per-round CheckboxListTile 'Round n')`; partial card (`Partial in this session (n)` + `Mark present`); absent card (`Absent (n)` + `Attended another session of this course.` + `Mark present`); (`!readOnly` →) `Add person` (`ManualAddForm edit-*`) + `Save changes`.
- **Data:** copies `_windows/_names/_rolls`; ops `_toggleWindow/_toggle(all rounds)/_remove/_markPresent(all rounds)/_add`; `_draft` snapshot for partial calc; `_absent` from `courseRoster(courseSessions)` minus any-window-here (empty sessions → []); save: `nowIso>oldTimestamp?nowIso:old` monotonic, preserve `startIso` + org, `noteLocalSave` (durable + outbox + best-effort flush; offline queues), log `edit: saved session <date>`, `pop(true)`.
- **Edges:** `readOnly` (web) hides Remove/toggles/Add/Save, shows banner; tri-state all/some/none; present = every window (same as exports); `startIso` preserved.
- **This is the ONE legitimate checkbox use** (professor-side per-round correction) — distinct from hold-and-tap bulk selection everywhere else.

### 5.7 `features/records/export_center_screen.dart` — ExportCenterScreen (`prof/courses/<course>/export`)
- **Does:** review/export past. `ClockHeader` + banner + `Export date range` (calendar_month, disabled empty) → `showDateRangePicker(first now-2y, last now+2y, initial 30d..now)` + count `<n> sessions` + rows (`title tightLabel`, subtitle `fullDate\nP present · W window(s)`, tap / `Export CSV` share icon) → `showCsvPreviewDialog` (`Close/Save/Share`). Export allowed on web (Save downloads in-browser); only hosting/retake stays native.
- **Data:** `readHistory` + `account.org` → filter `(course match) && (org empty either side else equal)` sort timestamp desc; per-session `withOrgLine(r.toCsv(),org)` (`Org,<org|legacy local-only>` literal line), filename `attendance_<label>_<date>_<id8>.csv`, subject `Attendance <label> <date>`; range `sessionsInRange` (dateIso inclusive, timestamp asc) → `withOrgLine(buildDateRangeMatrix(inRange), first.org)`, filename `attendance_<course>_<s>_<e>.csv`; save `saveTextFile` (`Saved to device: <path>` / `Save failed: <e>`), share `SharePlus(text,subject)`; logs `export: save/share …`. Writes none.
- **Matrix:** rows keyed by email PK sorted; header `Name,ID Number,Email,<dates>`; cell P = intersection-present else A; columns timestamp-sorted; same-day repeats disambiguate `HH:mm` (`<date> HH:mm` local); no-classes → `No classes took place in <start … end>.` (`…` ellipsis); empty `No sessions yet for this course.`; title `Export · <course>`.

### 5.8 Sync skim (what records read/write)
- `sessions.dart` (pure): `SessionTombstone(id,deletedAtIso UTC monotonic,org,course)`; `unionMergeRecords` (windows OR — mark never unmarked; names/rolls newer-non-empty wins; faceFlags union never unflagged; timestampIso max; startIso earliest-nonempty); `applyTombstones` (drop if `deletedAt >= timestamp`); `mergeHistoriesUnion` (add union, tombstones, newest-first); `PendingSession(id==record.id, org, attempts, nextRetryAtIso ''=due, updatedAtIso)` per-course FIFO; `sessionToDoc` (courseId/courseName mirror for rename, profUid/profEmail.lower/profName, org immutable on update, dateIso/timestampIso/startIso, windows/names/rolls copies, studentEmails lower-sorted, faceFlags, updatedAt; final statuses only — no vectors/biometrics); `docToRecord` (numeric names/rolls coerced `'${v}'`).
- `engine.dart`: `pendingCount` drives `UnsyncedBadge (N pending)`; `saveSessionLocal` (upsert + outbox, `outbox queued <id> (<n> sessions pending)`); `deleteSessionsLocal` (tombstone cap 500, `outbox tombstoned <n> (<m> deletes pending)`); `renameCourseLocal` (`outbox rename <old> → <new> (re-queued)`); `noteLocalSave` (durable + unawaited flush); `flush` single-flight (online probe `8s` ground truth; offline `SYNC offline (<p> pending) — outbox durable, will flush on reconnect`; tombstones first; sessions per-course FIFO union-merge-before-push with backoff `5s→1min→15min cap + jitter 0.75–1.25`; `processPendingAdds` + push resolved ids; converge pull + union + writeHistory + addCourse; `SYNC flush done: <p> pushed, <d> deleted, <r> queue-resolved, <rem> remaining`). Triggers: connectivity-hint edge (~5s debounce), app resume, 15-min backstop while non-empty.
- `record_helpers.dart`: `recordInCourse`, `dateIsoOf (yyyy-MM-dd)`, `todayIso`.

Tags: `BLE` scan/ADV/RX/RSSI/hint/probe, `MESH` relay armed/forward/skip (disarmed silent), `LAN` HTTPS/announce/broadcast/beacon/presence/leave/manual/waiting, `SEC` ticket/signing, `NET` window-fetch/token/ACK, `SYNC` edges/flush/backfill, `CLOCK` drift median/banner (+ NAV/FACE/STATE/TRANSPORT/CRYPTO/SESSION). ## 7. Gaps / divergences / pre-existing doc mismatches (must surface, never silently guess)

1. **Enrollment-status signal for Mark gate (§3.4):** no doc states where the check happens or what "not enrolled" means concretely (no claim? no gallery? claim without `enroll/result` success?). Some signal must exist (RoleHub last-mode-first resume). Wire the SAME signal; if none covers cleanly, surface.
2. **ID-edit write path (§5.1):** if ID is immutable server-side, render read-only + report; exposing edit without a write path is new business logic, out of scope for presentation pass.
3. **3-vs-5-angle mismatch (§6.2):** `README` robustness notes say 3 stills (Centre/Left/Right); `SCREEN_MAP` + enroll code say 5 (centre/left/right/up/down). Build two-oval overlay to match the actual capture-controller code; report which count it is.
4. **Take/Retake on CourseOverview** diverges from §3.1a records-only (hosting exclusively via Live). Rebuild removes hosting affordance from Courses tab.
5. **Manual inbox checkboxes** diverge from hold-and-tap-everywhere rule (prof `sessions/<id>/edit` per-round correction is the one checkbox exception). Rebuild replaces inbox checkboxes with hold-and-tap + `features/manual_attendance/` module.
6. **Move-cadence copy** says `once a month` (register) vs `once a week` (add-other-role/lost-phone); code is 30-day — `once a month` accurate.
7. **README system-log toggles** stale vs push-only terminal. **README 3-still** note stale vs 5-angle code (see 3).
8. **No bottom bar, no Account routes, no SetupFlowScreen, no DetailsExpander, no theme switcher, no Gmail photo, no `courses/*` rename, no device→Account fold, no manual_attendance module, no log drawer** — all spec, none in code. Rebuild implements per plan; anything unimplementable without behavior change gets flagged in the integration log, never guessed.

## Phase 1 record (2026-09-10) — backend/frontend separation audit (no code changed)

Method: `grep` timers + `setState` owners + cloud-write sites across `lib/screens/`, `lib/features/`, `lib/widgets/`. Outcome per file class:

- **CONFIRMED clean — `screens/student_home.dart`, `screens/take_attendance.dart`:** own all orchestration timers (refresh/session/room-poll/presence/manual/rewait/hint-retry; idle-poll/elapsed), drivers, drafts, snapshots, wakelock, nav. They compose `features/` sections; no widget-tree move needed.
- **CONFIRMED presentational — paint/clock timers stay where they are:** `welcome_screen` hero timer (paint-only), `debug_log_screen` flush-coalesce timer (buffer management), `prox_verdict` breath, `prox_states/prox_cards` pulse dots, `clock.dart` 1s clock. None own business logic; moving them would churn with zero safety benefit.
- **CONFIRMED self-contained records pattern — `features/records/*` (7 screens, no `screens/` host):** their store/cloud calls are data-load + user-initiated mutations only (`readHistory/readStudentSessions/pullStudentSessions/writeStudentSessions`, `renameCourseLocal/deleteSessionsLocal/noteLocalSave` in overview/edit, `hideSession` in detail). No timers, no drivers, no drafts. No `screens/course_*` host exists and creating 7 new hosts would risk behavior change for no isolation gain — these files are **exempt** from the split; section owners must preserve their data logic verbatim during rebuild.
- **FLAGGED M1 — `features/enrollment/enroll_capture.dart` mixes session-driver orchestration into `features/`:** owns camera open/close, the `_autoLoop` classify-fill loop, `_saveAll`, dispose latch. Mechanical move target: the `screens/setup_flow_screen.dart` orchestrator (Setup-flow section). The two-oval overlay swap happens in the same section — the move must be called out separately from the visual change, never bundled silently.
- **FLAGGED M2 — `features/entry/entry_flow.dart` is orchestration colocated in `features/`:** all entry auth/role/cloud/nav decisions. Exempt from relocation (moving it touches every entry screen's imports for zero behavior benefit) **on condition it never gains widget trees** — it stays a decisions-only module, same standing as drivers in `core/`.
- **FLAGGED M3 — `widgets/manual_add.dart` mixes search/queue orchestration into a shared widget:** owns debounce `Timer`, online-probe cache, `searchStudents` queries, `writePendingAdds` queue writes alongside the form UI. Mechanical move target: `features/manual_attendance/` module (Live-tab section), which then owns search+queue+selection while screens compose it. Until then, section owners must preserve its submit paths (add-at-once / exact-ID resolve / offline queue / Already-marked-present) byte-for-byte.
- **Checked `live_sections.dart` inbox `noteLocalSave`:** mirrors the host's snapshot path for section deep-links; not a mix, preserve as-is until the manual-attendance module absorbs it.

No file was split by force. M1/M3 move during their rebuild sections (mechanical, called out); everything else is confirmed or exempt above.
